_comment: Map script speaker names to ElevenLabs voice IDs. Run `python generate.py --list-voices` to see the voices on your account, then paste IDs here. The IDs below are ElevenLabs premade voices as sensible starting points - swap freely.

WANDERER.note: The Wanderer. Urbane, erudite, delighted storyteller - 'The Rest Is History' host energy: playful scholarly digressions, warm wit. Premade 'George' (British storyteller) - a keeper.

ANNOUNCER.note: Sponsor reads. Smooth, NPR-deadpan, completely sincere. Premade 'Sarah' placeholder.

KEEPER.note: Bellin, keeper of Midreach waystation. Jack Burton trucker-on-the-radio swagger: unbothered, self-mythologizing, talks about himself in the third person. Premade 'Roger' (laid-back, casual, resonant).

DISPATCHER.note: Caravan Guild dispatcher, Lane Law Minute. Clipped, procedural, zero warmth. Premade 'Daniel' placeholder.

PITCHMAN.note: Elven Market pitchman. Fast-talking 1940s huckster energy. Premade 'Callum' placeholder.

JINGLE.note: Jingle singer for Tsalaxa tag. Bright, cheerful, wrong. Premade 'Jessica' (playful, bright).
